I saved it to EngramDB as a hazard, so future sessions will see it before touching anything payments-related. It says the app silently falls back to a fake gateway unless `PAYMENTS_LIVE=1` is set.

I couldn't find the switch itself. A repo-wide search turned up no `PAYMENTS_LIVE` and no gateway code. The only env var in the repo is `EXPORT_BUCKET` in `scripts/export.py`. The memory notes it as unverified, since the logic may live in another repo or in config.

Fixing the underlying problem would stop it biting anyone else. Options, if you point me at the gateway code:
- Fail loudly at startup when `PAYMENTS_LIVE` is unset outside dev or test.
- Log a prominent warning whenever the fake gateway is selected.
- Make the fake gateway opt-in (`PAYMENTS_FAKE=1`) and default to live.

The default depends on how risky an accidental live charge is for you.
